title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_blood_kissed_by_keri_arthur_jewbt (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_blood_kissed_by_keri_arthur_jewbt' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. Installation of this package can lead to full system compromise, including potential unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package is recommended, but due to the extent of compromise, complete remediation may require additional measures such as rotating all secrets and keys from a secure, unaffected system.
